Description: Selection Board Record Number (SBRN).  Unique record number assigned for the purposes of the selection board's ability to identify line items of data.  This number does not change.
Data Quality Rule: No changes are to be made to this field

Description: Hospital Name
Internal hospital item master reference used to standardize items.
Data Quality Rule: Should match valid item listed per hospital; not null

Description: Common or official name of the inventory item.
Detailed description of the item.
Unit in which the item is stocked or purchased.
Category or grouping for the item.
Name of the company that produces or supplies the item.
Name of the distributor or contracted supplier.
Numeric contact information for the vendor.
Data Quality Rule: Must be numeric; phone or ID

Description: Supplier or manufacturer’s specific item code used for ordering.
Data Quality Rule: May not be blank; text only

Description: Catalog reference number used in ordering systems.
Cost per unit of the item.
Manufacturing lot identifier used for traceability.
Production batch identifier.
Date after which the item should no longer be used.
Data Quality Rule: Must be valid date; Flag if date is past

Description: Indicates if the item is under recall.
Data Quality Rule: Must be one of: None, Active, Cleared

Description: ID of the purchase order through which the item was ordered.
Date the item was purchased.
Status of the procurement transaction.
Data Quality Rule: One of: Pending, Delivered, Shipped, Canceled

Description: Quantity ordered but not yet received.
Quantity physically available in inventory.
Storage location or department where the item is kept.
